### What changed and how does it work?

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)

mysql --comments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4000 -u root -e "set @@global.tidb_enable_dist_task = 0;set @@global.tidb_ddl_reorg_worker_cnt = 1;create table test.t(c int primary key, c2 int);split table test.t between (0) and (10000) regions 10;insert into test.t values (1,1), (3000, 3000), (6000, 6000);"

./bin/tidb-server-failpoint -P 4001 --store=tikv --host=127.0.0.1 --status=10081 --path=127.0.0.1:2379 --log-file=/tmp/tidb-1.log

issue_context.title: For lightning external engine (global sort), engine TS should keep same after subtask failover
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

like local engine, the TS is saved in local engine's metadata, we should also let subtask metadata determine the TS.

review_comments: we can skip GetTS if ts != 0
Oh I should ~let caller pass a TS, and~ skip this `allocateTSIfNotExists`. So add index will not call `allocateTSIfNotExists` and no need to test its error.
it's also used in `generateLocalEngineConfig` in local fast reorg of DDL
For DXF, if we use the same TS, is there any chance that two keys are conflicts but they cannot be detected by `CollectRemoteDupRows`?
It's unlikely because two same keys are adjacent in global sort files, and they will be included in one subtask because start/end key of subtask can not separate them.
